description: This PHP source file defines a class 'registry_v4_1' that extends 'registry_v4' and includes methods to register web service functions and complex data types for SuiteCRM, an extension of SugarCRM. It handles registration of functions like 'get_relationships' and 'get_modified_relationships', and defines various data structures used in web service communication.

classes.name: registry_v4_1
classes.description: Class extending 'registry_v4' that registers functions and types for SuiteCRM v4.1 web services support.

methods.name: registerFunction
methods.description: Registers web service functions 'get_relationships' and 'get_modified_relationships' with their parameter and return types.

methods.name: registerTypes
methods.description: Registers complex data types used in the web service, such as error structures and relationship entry types.
